scopes.description: Complete supplied Stata preparation workflow for the primary comparison panel and both distinct GDF-related and GDF-unrelated branches. The do file reports the code that prepares the final files on which the analyses described

evidence.description: Author README describes the absent primary AIDA firm-year panel and its CRIMINAL and ANNO_OP fields.
evidence.quote:
1) mafia_project_full_def_operazioni_rev1.dta. 

This file includes raw data at firm-year level from the database AIDA (Bureau Van Dijk)
it includes also financial data for the criminal firms, identified as described in section 3.2 in Chircop et al. (2022). 
The dummy variable CRIMINAL identifies Mafia-related firms, it takes the value of 1 for criminal firms and 0 for non-criminal firms.
The variable ANNO_OP identify the year of the Anti-Mafia Action that removed that specific firm.

2) operazioni_gdf_touse

This files includes the classification of the Anti-Mafia Police Actions between those carried out by the "Guardia di Finanza" 
and those carried out by other police forces. The dummy GDF is 1 for Anti-Mafia Police Actions carried out by "Guardia di Finanza", 0 otherwise.

evidence.description: Author README describes the separate AIDA panel used for the GDF-only branch.

This file containes raw data from the database AIDA (Bureau Van Dijk) for the test on police actions carried out by Guardia di Finanza only

evidence.description: The supplied program builds 2005 municipality-industry counts and saves master_rev2 after the many-firm interactions.
evidence.quote:
use  mafia_project_full_def_operazioni_rev1,clear

keep if ANNO==2005
bysort COMUNE_Istat  CODATECO_2 : egen number_firms=count(CF)
egen unique2= tag(COMUNE_Istat  CODATECO_2)
keep if unique2==1
save comune_number_firms,replace

use  master_rev1,clear

merge m:1 COMUNE_Istat  CODATECO_2 using comune_number_firms, keepusing(number_firms)
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge
sum number_firms,d
g many_firm= 0
replace many_firm =1 if number_firms > r(p50)

g many_firm_inter= many_firm*post_treated
g many_firm_post= many_firm*post
g many_firm_treated= many_firm*treated
g many_assets=log_assets_w*many_firm
g many_DE = many_firm* D_E_w
g many_ebitda= many_firm*ebitda_assets_w


save  master_rev2,replace
